name: Ether Spider

offensiveAbilities.name: Ether Spider Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d6 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 2 and Slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d6 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 3 and Slowed 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Ethereal Step
offensiveAbilities.description: The ether spider shifts to either the Ethereal Plane or the Material Plane. The ether spider can remain on the Ethereal Plane indefinitely without ill effect. While there, it can see clearly onto the Material Plane with a range of 60 feet. On its first round in an encounter, the ether spider can use this ability once as a free action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ethereal Web Trap
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature hit by the ether spider's web attack is Immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface (Escape dc=22).

offensiveAbilities.name: Web Burst
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The ether spider flings a gout of stored webs in a 30ft Cone. These webs can pass between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. Each creature in the area is Immobilized, as ethereal web trap, unless it succeeds at a DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Occultism, DC 20
